modeDifference.metric: ImageMagick absolute-error changed-pixel count in 1600x500 lower scene crop (excludes sky/backdrop)

method: All source GLBs remain unchanged. Browser-only shared MeshToonMaterial instances use a nearest-filtered three-step ramp; original base-color and emissive channels/strengths are retained separately. PBR roughness/metallic/environment response is not reproduced. Procedural mineral fine noise remains unbaked; source constant base colors and roughness are used.
limitations: Static crowd poses only; no animation. Audience count/layout beyond the ten original study samples is a review visualization choice, not an approved population target.
Background is fixed; verify mode difference on scene surfaces.
Software renderer metrics are local structural evidence only, not mobile/device budgets.
No mineral noise bake, texture synthesis, game integration, collision/support claims, or changes to source geometry/assets.
Study composition intentionally retains inherited skyline crop and exact camera framing.
